record.question: Which district in Mizoram ranked highest in NITI Aayog second edition of the North Eastern Region District SDG Index 2023-24?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
NITI Aayog’s second-edition report, published 7 July 2025, reports a score of 81.43 for Hnahthial and identifies it as the highest-scoring district in the entire North Eastern Region. This supports Hnahthial as the leading Mizoram district within that edition. A report-period ranking should not be presented as a live 2026 rank.

Reference: https://www.niti.gov.in/node/1708
